Amy Poehler and Michael Schur's Dig Is No Parks and Rec—But It's Still a Fun Trip

Dig is sure to catch the eye of anyone scanning for signs of a post-midterms vibe shift. (Never mind that it was announced last spring, just a few months into a second Trump term some interpreted as a long-term rightward swerve.) The Peacock comedy, whose 10-episode first season arrives on Nov. 23, reunites Amy Poehler and Michael Schur , the duo behind the ultimate Obama-era sitcom: Parks and Recreation .
